sql: SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS k, (CAST("TV_series"."Share" AS REAL) / "TV_series"."Rating") AS m1 FROM "TV_series" WHERE (CAST("TV_series"."Share" AS REAL) / "TV_series"."Rating") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: TV_series.household audience share relative to household rating
why: household audience share / household rating: a ratio of two quantities in percent
rank TV_series rows by household audience share relative to household rating

sql: SELECT "TV_series"."Channel" AS k, ("TV_series"."Rating" - "TV_series"."Share") AS m1 FROM "TV_series" WHERE ("TV_series"."Rating" - "TV_series"."Share") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: TV_series.household rating minus household audience share
why: household rating - household audience share: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one TV series episode
rank TV_series rows by household rating minus household audience share
